caption: The video captures a night scene over a calm body of water, with a low, lit city skyline stretching across the horizon. A volley of firework bursts occupies the upper-middle sky: one large spherical burst on the right, a horizontal row of smaller gold bursts to its left, and a couple of tiny points above the row. The water mirrors the bright bursts and the skyline lights. The camera framing stays fixed throughout. The large right-hand burst, already expanded, holds its position while its hue drifts between greenish-white and pink/red as its dots fade. The tiny points above the row grow into several new pink and red spherical bursts that expand in place rather than translating, while the gold row holds its line, its dots twinkling before dimming as the upper bursts brighten. Thin near-vertical streaks then appear and lengthen beneath several bursts as the spheres dissolve into separated, twinkling dots. The reflections on the water track these changes, jittering with small ripples.
relations: The large right burst holds position as its dots fade and hue shifts between greenish-white and pink/red.
Tiny points above the row expand in place into new pink and red spherical bursts.
The gold row holds its line, twinkling before dimming, while vertical streaks lengthen beneath dissolving spheres.
Water reflections track the bursts' brightness and color changes, jittering with small ripples.
